schema.upstreamImplemented: Mesa PanVK source advertises/implements the path
schema.runtimeExposed: queried from the exact ICD on this device
schema.runtimeTested: a real workload on this tree exercised the path
schema.sourceImplemented: exact pinned Mesa source implements the extension or compatibility component
schema.nativeHardware: target hardware natively implements the feature
schema.nativeDriverExposed: base PanVK ICD exposes the native feature
schema.nativeVulkanFeatureBit: base PanVK ICD reports the Vulkan feature bit
schema.compatAvailable: compatibility component built and loader-discovered in its tested model
schema.compatTested: compatibility implementation passed device correctness workloads
schema.compatLoadTested: Android loader discovered and loaded the component
schema.compatComposesWithPanvk: tested loader path selected the staged PanVK ICD
